headline: Sudan Accuses Ethiopia and UAE of Drone Strikes on Energy Infrastructure
summary: Sudan's army-led government accused Ethiopia and the United Arab Emirates of conducting drone strikes targeting domestic power stations and fuel storage sites.
why: The ongoing civil war in Sudan threatens regional energy infrastructure and stability across the Red Sea corridor and Horn of Africa.

impacts.name: Sudan
impacts.why: Attacks on critical power and fuel distribution depots worsen domestic energy shortages and economic paralysis.
